hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git add -A|git add \.( |"|$)|git commit -a( |$)|--no-verify|git push[^|]*--force'; then echo 'BLOCKED: use explicit git add <file>. Never -A, ., commit -a, --no-verify, push --force (CLAUDE.md rule 1).' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path":[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*"file_path":[[:space:]]*"([^"]+)"/\1/'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5;; *vps*.js) node --check "$FILE" 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
cat docs/index.md 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '--- DoD report obligatoire en fin de session (/dod-report) ---'; exit 0

CODE_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'); REPORT_TOUCHED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'docs/prompts/REPORT/'); if [ "${CODE_CHANGED:-0}" -gt 0 ] && [ "${REPORT_TOUCHED:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: code changed but no DoD report. Run /dod-report first.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
bash scripts/session-summary.sh 2>/dev/null || echo 'session summary skipped'; exit 0
